StudentId.name: X-Student-Id
StudentId.description: Scaffold-only identity header; replace with verified bearer-token middleware. Deprecated: use Authorization Bearer actor claims.

GuardianId.name: X-Guardian-Id
GuardianId.description: Scaffold-only linked guardian identity, required when a minor's consent is written. Replace with verified actor claims. Deprecated: use Authorization Bearer actor claims.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for formal stage-attempt start runtime and planned for future submit routes. ASCII 8-128 using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

FormalIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
FormalIdempotencyKey.description: Required for formal stage-attempt start runtime. ASCII 8-128 using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

IfMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
IfMatchRevision.description: planned future contract: If-Match-Revision will be required for revisioned writes once runtime revision support is implemented. Not implemented in this slice.

LegacyGuardianHeader.name: X-Guardian-Id
LegacyGuardianHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility guardian actor for consent writes; use verified bearer actor claims.

Forbidden.description: Guardian or voice consent gate denied the operation

entitlements.description: Server-side active or grace-period entitlement codes for the current student. Expired, revoked, or past valid_until records are omitted.

StableErrorCode.description: Stable error-code registry. IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY is deprecated and retained only for compatibility; P1.1 does not emit it.

StartStageAttemptResponse.description: Formal P1.3 Start/Get runtime response. Item and option IDs are immutable attempt snapshot IDs and do not expose private answer keys.

SubmitStageAttemptRequest.description: Formal P1.3 submit runtime request. Null selectedOptionId explicitly represents a skipped item. Client score, passed, mastery, due, occurred_at, or evidence fields are not accepted.

StageAttemptResultResponse.description: Formal P1.3 server-scored result. Scores are derived from immutable answer-key snapshots, not client-supplied values.

StudentKnowledgeProjection.description: Current P1.3-6 materialized mastery/due projection. It mirrors student_knowledge rows and excludes future fields such as stabilityDays or attemptCount.

BearerAuth.description: Verified actor bearer authentication. Required for formal stage-attempt runtime; legacy identity headers are not accepted on formal routes.

LegacyStudentHeader.name: X-Student-Id
LegacyStudentHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility identity used by the current scaffold runtime; replace with planned BearerAuth middleware.

LegacyGuardianHeader.name: X-Guardian-Id
LegacyGuardianHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility guardian actor used by the current scaffold runtime; replace with planned BearerAuth middleware.

x-runtime-contract-status.authentication: BearerAuth is implemented for formal stage-attempt runtime; deprecated X-Student-Id/X-Guardian-Id headers remain only for legacy non-formal compatibility routes
x-runtime-contract-status.idempotency: formal stage-attempt start and submit use Idempotency-Key; deprecated compatibility-only IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY is not emitted
x-runtime-contract-status.revision: planned: If-Match-Revision is not implemented and is not currently required
